title: Customer Service Administrator - Irvine
description:
Boyd Recruitment are currently looking to recruit a motivated and customer-focused Customer Service Administrator on behalf of a well-established utilities contractor based in Irvine.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous customer service or administration experience to join a busy team, acting as a key point of contact for customers and ensuring enquiries, updates and requests are handled efficiently and professionally.

The Role
- Act as the main point of contact for customers, providing a professional and helpful service.
- Manage incoming customer enquiries and ensure all queries are dealt with promptly.
- Maintain accurate records of customer communications, including telephone calls, emails and written correspondence.
- Provide regular updates to customers regarding work schedules, progress and delivery timescales.
- Liaise with internal departments, including Pre-Vetting, Traffic Management and Operations, to ensure customer requests are processed efficiently.
- Handle customer complaints and enquiries, working towards timely and effective resolutions.
- Manage customer expectations by providing clear information and realistic timescales.
- Ensure all customer interactions are recorded accurately on the relevant systems.
- Work closely with the wider administrative team to improve processes and customer service standards.
- Support the department with general administrative duties as required.

Essential Requirements
- Previous experience in a customer-facing or customer service role.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office 365.
- Strong organisational and time-management skills.
- Excellent attention to detail.
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritise workloads effectively.
- Confident dealing with customers and handling challenging situations professionally.
- A proactive and positive approach to work.

Desirable Experience
- Previous experience within the utilities or construction sectors.
- Experience dealing with customer enquiries and complaints.
- Familiarity with customer management or administration systems.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is approachable, organised and confident communicating with customers at all levels. The successful candidate will be able to work effectively within a busy team, manage competing priorities and maintain a high standard of customer service.

The ability to remain professional under pressure and take ownership of customer enquiries will be essential.

Interested?

If you have previous customer service or administration experience and are looking for your next opportunity, we would love to hear from you.

title: Traffic Management & Generators Administrator - Irvine
description:
Boyd Recruitment are currently looking to recruit an organised and proactive Traffic Management & Generators Administrator on behalf of a well-established utilities contractor based in Irvine.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous administration or coordination experience to join a busy operational team, supporting the planning and delivery of traffic management and generator requirements across various projects.

The Role
- Provide day-to-day administrative support to the Traffic Management and Generators departments.
- Coordinate traffic management bookings and arrangements for upcoming projects and site works.
- Liaise with traffic management contractors, suppliers and internal operational teams.
- Assist with arranging generator deliveries, collections and movements between sites.
- Maintain accurate records of equipment, bookings, schedules and project requirements.
- Monitor upcoming work schedules to ensure traffic management and generator requirements are arranged in advance.
- Communicate with site teams to confirm requirements, delivery times and any changes to arrangements.
- Assist with processing purchase orders, invoices and delivery documentation.
- Monitor equipment availability and report any issues or delays to the relevant teams.
- Ensure all relevant paperwork and records are maintained accurately.
- Provide general administrative support to the wider operations team as required.

Essential Requirements
- Previous experience in an administration or coordination role.
- Strong organisational and time-management skills.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook and Excel.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritise workloads effectively.
- Confident communicating with suppliers, subcontractors and internal teams.
- A proactive approach with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Desirable Experience
- Previous experience within the utilities, construction or infrastructure sectors.
- Experience coordinating traffic management requirements.
- Experience arranging plant, equipment or generator movements.
- Previous experience working within an operational or logistics environment.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is highly organised, reliable and comfortable working in a busy operational environment.

The successful candidate will have excellent communication skills, be confident managing changing priorities and have the ability to ensure that equipment, resources and arrangements are coordinated efficiently to support ongoing site operations.

Interested?

If you have previous administration or coordination experience and are interested in this opportunity, we would love to hear from you.

title: HR Administrator - Irvine
description:
Boyd Recruitment are currently looking to recruit an organised and motivated HR Administrator on behalf of a well-established utilities contractor based in Irvine.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous HR or administration experience who is looking to join a busy and growing business, providing essential administrative support to the wider HR team.

The Role
- Provide day-to-day administrative support to the HR department.
- Maintain and update employee records and personnel files.
- Assist with the preparation of employment contracts, offer letters and other HR documentation.
- Support the onboarding process for new employees, including collecting right-to-work documentation and ensuring all relevant paperwork is completed.
- Assist with recruitment administration, including arranging interviews and communicating with candidates.
- Maintain accurate records of holidays, sickness absence and employee information.
- Respond to general HR queries from employees and management.
- Assist with payroll-related administration and the preparation of relevant information.
- Ensure all HR documentation is handled confidentially and in line with company procedures.
- Support the wider team with general administrative duties as required.

Essential Requirements
- Previous experience in an administrative role, ideally within HR.
- Strong organisational and time-management skills.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Good IT skills, particularly Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information professionally.
- A proactive approach with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is reliable, approachable and highly organised, with a keen eye for detail and the ability to work effectively as part of a team.

Previous experience within a busy HR department would be advantageous, although candidates with strong general administration experience and an interest in developing their HR career will also be considered.

Interested?

If you have previous administration or HR experience and are interested in this opportunity, we would love to hear from you.

title: Continuous Improvement Administrator - Irvine
description:
Boyd Recruitment are currently looking to recruit an organised and detail-oriented Continuous Improvement Administrator on behalf of a well-established utilities contractor based in Irvine.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous administration experience who has an interest in business processes, operational efficiency and continuous improvement. The successful candidate will support the business in identifying opportunities to improve processes, maintaining accurate records and helping drive efficiencies across various departments.

The Role
- Provide administrative support to the Continuous Improvement team.
- Assist with identifying and recording opportunities for process improvements across the business.
- Maintain and update continuous improvement trackers, reports and documentation.
- Monitor progress of improvement actions and follow up with relevant departments.
- Liaise with internal teams to gather information and support improvement initiatives.
- Assist with reviewing existing processes and identifying areas where efficiencies can be achieved.
- Prepare reports, presentations and updates for management.
- Maintain accurate records of completed and ongoing improvement activities.
- Support the implementation of new procedures, systems and working practices.
- Help ensure company processes and documentation remain up to date.
- Provide general administrative support to the wider team as required.

Essential Requirements
- Previous experience in an administration or office-based role.
- Strong organisational and time-management skills.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
- A proactive approach with good problem-solving skills.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a wider team.

Desirable Experience
- Previous experience in a continuous improvement or operational support role.
- Experience maintaining reports, spreadsheets and performance trackers.
- Knowledge of business improvement processes or quality management systems.
- Previous experience within the utilities, construction or engineering sectors.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is proactive, organised and has a keen eye for detail. The successful candidate will enjoy working with different departments, identifying opportunities to improve working practices and supporting the business in delivering more efficient processes.

This would suit someone with a strong administrative background who is looking to develop their experience within a business improvement environment.

Interested?

If you have previous administration experience and are interested in this opportunity, we would love to hear from you.

title: PA

title: Logistics Coordinator
description:
Junior Logistics Coordinator
Location: Irvine
Salary: 27,495 per annum
Contract: Permanent, full-time
Working Hours: Fully office-based
Build Your Career in Logistics!
Pertemps are currently recruiting for a Logistics Coordinator to join a busy and growing business based in Irvine. This is an excellent opportunity for a graduate or an organised, computer-literate individual looking to establish a long-term career within the logistics and transport industry.
No previous logistics experience is essential. We are particularly interested in candidates who have strong IT skills, excellent attention to detail and a genuine interest in developing their knowledge of logistics, transport planning and business operations.
You will play an important role in coordinating day-to-day logistics activities, helping ensure staff, drivers and vehicles are organised efficiently to meet operational requirements and customer deadlines.
Key Responsibilities
- Assist with the day-to-day planning and coordination of logistics and transport activities.
- Organise schedules for drivers, staff and vehicles to ensure operational requirements are met.
- Communicate with drivers, internal departments and external transport providers to ensure smooth operations.
- Help manage staff availability and arrange appropriate cover where required.
- Request and review transport quotations, supporting cost-effective planning.
- Maintain accurate records, schedules and information using internal computer systems.
- Monitor transport arrangements and communicate any changes, delays or issues to relevant departments.
- Support the coordination of teams attending external customer locations.
- Ensure transport arrangements comply with relevant safety regulations and working time requirements.
- Develop an understanding of vehicle types, transport requirements, load restrictions and route planning.
- Work closely with colleagues across different departments to ensure effective day-to-day operations.

What We're Looking For
This role would suit someone at the beginning of their career who is keen to learn and develop within the logistics industry.
We're looking for:
- Good computer skills and confidence using Microsoft Office and business systems.
- Strong organisational and time management skills.
- Excellent attention to detail.
- Confident communication skills, both written and verbal.
- The ability to prioritise tasks and manage changing demands.
- A proactive approach with a willingness to learn.
- Someone who enjoys problem-solving and working as part of a team.
- An interest in logistics, transport or supply chain management.

A degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration or a related subject would be advantageous, but is not essential.
Previous experience in logistics or transport coordination would also be beneficial, although full training will be provided.
What's on Offer?
- Permanent employment opportunity.
- Competitive salary of 27,495 per annum.
- Fully office-based position in Irvine.
- Opportunity to develop a career within the logistics and transport sector.
- Training and ongoing development.
- The chance to gain valuable experience in a varied and interesting operational role.

Interested?
If you're organised, computer literate and looking for an opportunity to build a career in logistics, we'd love to hear from you!
Apply today through Pertemps to find out more.
